newsitem.title: CANADA: Suzy Shier sees better year Feb 1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Suzy Shier sees better year Feb 1 profit.

text.p: Suzy Shier Ltd said on Friday that it expects a "significant improvement" net earnings from operations for the year ending February 1.
The improved results over the previous fiscal year will come mainly from "substantially" stronger results in is Suzy Shier, La Senza and Silk & Satin stores in Canada.

The company also said that its share of the projected net loss of its U.K. unit La Senza Plc for the year ending February 1 should be reduced to about C$2.6 million or C$0.21 a share, compared with a net loss of C$3.2 million or C$0.27 a share a year earlier.
La Senza Plc reported on Friday that same store sales for December were 9.8 percent higher that in the year earlier month, with gross margins broadly in line with expectations, Suzy Shier said.
In May 1996, Suzy Shier sold 39.8 percent of the share capital of La Senza Plc in an initial public offering on the Alternative Investment Market of the London Stock Exchange.
Results of the U.K. unit are consolidated with the parent company's.
